Rhea P.: heads-up: small repro where our JS SDK built with esbuild+vite in CJS mode breaks on edge (auth header present but requests 401).
Rhea P.: repo: github.com/redwood-internal/repro-edge-esbuild-shim (internal)
Omar V.: what are the symptoms?
Rhea P.: runtime shows 
```
TypeError: client.send is not a function
ERROR: 401 Unauthorized
```
Rhea P.: ESM build works; CJS build (vite lib formats:['cjs'] or esbuild format:'cjs') deployed to edge fails.
Jules: likely default export shape changed by esbuild CJS transform; edge loader resolves the cjs entry and callers hit an object wrapper.
Sam: minimal steps I used:
1) clone repro && npm ci
2) npm run build:cjs (vite -> formats:['cjs'])
3) deno task start:edge or deploy to edge runner
4) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost/_send -> 401 + TypeError
Rhea P.: vite snippet that reproduces: 
```js
build: { lib:{ entry: 'src/index.ts', formats:['cjs'] }, commonjsOptions:{ transformMixedEsModules:true } }
```
Jules: short-term: publish an interop shim at package root that normalizes exports (`module.exports = exports.default || exports`) or prefer ESM in onboarding samples.
Sam: I'll add a CI edge-smoke job that builds cjs/esm and runs a tiny edge emulation. build-bot: CI job 2245 finished, artifacts uploaded.
Rhea P.: action items: (1) Sam add CI smoke, (2) Jules draft shim PR for canary, (3) docs update for onboarding sampleapps to default to ESM. Ping me for reviews. :thumbsup:
